# Three-section loft interpolation

Both workers build a solid through the three placed sections. The
middle interpolation parameter differs, so the side surfaces and the
measures differ. `expected.json` records the desired oracle geometry
and marks the arris fixture as a strict expected failure. The adjacent
`oracle.json` records the run of `oracle.py`. The independent volume
integral and the section parameters are in [the loft fixture
notes](../../lofts/README.md#three-section-regressions), ADR-0026.
